title: fix(spec): a user field over a text column passes the type-compat check; ADR-0015 names the odata vocabulary

epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dhraZ7BwSanQPGEAb

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiH18zL8aJRKfkWPzKCnyMP2)_

Fixes #27917

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

**Fable review owed.** The review quota was out when this PR was opened. It stays draft until the independent full review, the contract review PASS on head and an authorized approval (Tier H: `docs/adr/**`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 一是 ADR-0015 §4.6 的方言清单补上 `odata`，并指向 `DIALECT_ALIASES.odata`（代码在 #27880 已加）。二是 `user` 字段加入类型矩阵 `text` 行的 exact 集合：外部表里用文本列存平台用户 id 的 `user` 字段，启动校验不再报 `type_mismatch` 错误。整数行（`integer` / `bigint`）不加。
- **为什么：** 实测平台用户 id（`sys_user.id`）永远是字符串：better-auth 为每个用户生成 32 位字母数字串，引擎直写时 SQL 驱动生成 16 位 nanoid，既不是 UUID 也不是整数。文本列装得下，整数列装不下，所以只放宽 `text` 行。
- **风险与回滚：** 只放宽一个接受集合，之前通过的不会变成失败；回滚即 revert。
- **需要您做的：** 合并前批准（改了 ADR，Tier H）。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.ts`.** `user` joins the `text` row's exact set (it was already exact under `uuid`). A comment on the row records the measurement and why the integer rows stay closed while `lookup` / `master_detail` are open there: a `user` field's target is fixed to `sys_user`, so the column holds a platform user id, whose shape is the platform's and not the remote system's.
- **`docs/adr/0015-external-datasource-federation.md`.** §4.6 lists `odata` among the dialects, with one sentence naming the two non-SQL vocabularies: `DIALECT_ALIASES.mongo` (BSON type names) and `DIALECT_ALIASES.odata` (EDM primitive types, except `Edm.Duration` and the geography / geometry families, left unmapped for review). The `Amended by` line records it as a dialect-list-only amendment.
- **`packages/spec/src/data/type-compat.test.ts`.** One case pins the decision both ways: `user` is exact over `varchar(255)`, `text`, postgres `citext`, bigquery `STRING`, odata `Edm.String` (and still over `uuid` / `Edm.Guid`); it is refused over `integer`, `bigint`, postgres `int8`, `Edm.Int32`, `Edm.Int64`, `boolean` and `jsonb`, while `lookup` stays exact over the same integer columns. A second case pins that the draft still suggests `text` for a text column (the suggestion is read from the column alone).
- **`.changeset/27917-type-compat-user-text.md`.** `@objectstack/spec` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Why

### The measurement (`sys_user.id`)

- **better-auth 1.7.12, the version `@objectstack/plugin-auth` pins.** Five `auth.api.signUpEmail` calls through a `createAdapterFactory` adapter configured as `objectql-adapter.ts` configures it (no `advanced.database.generateId`) wrote five `user` rows. Every id was 32 characters, all alphanumeric, not all-digit, not UUID-shaped (for example `jaS4bSf4BGL50JWp7UaSlvZFEEAKHKiE`). Admin create and the user import go through `auth.api.createUser`, the same id path.
- **The SQL driver.** A row written through the engine without an id gets `nanoid(DEFAULT_ID_LENGTH)` with `DEFAULT_ID_LENGTH = 16` (`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`), a string; a caller-supplied id is stored verbatim.
- **Decision.** A text column carries every one of those, so `user` is exact under `text`. No path produces an integer user id, so `user` stays refused under `integer` / `bigint`. This follows the card's own condition ("the integer rows only if a platform user id can be an integer").

### What an author can declare

The `user` field's own schema is unchanged. The only reader of the matrix that refuses is Gate 2 (`validateObject` in `service-datasource`): a federated object with a `user` field over a text column used to get a `type_mismatch` **error** (boot fails under `onMismatch: 'fail'`) and now passes. Nothing that passed before fails now. The draft generator never suggests `user` (suggestion is per column and stays `text`), so imports are unchanged.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/type-compat.test.ts`: 29 passed.
- Reverse check from the committed fix: removing `'user'` from the `text` row alone fails the new case at the `varchar(255)` assertion (`expected false to be true`, line 190); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 85 families on `ecf8b5c4`; all 85 run with exit codes recorded before any pipe. Four exited 3 on the first pass (not measured: plugin-teardown self-test fixture, doc-formula-expressions, dual-build-cjs-loads, lean-entry-closure) and exit 0 after fetching the fixture commit and building `./packages/**`. `--ran`: 85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (test-typecheck ledger held). `vitest run src/data/` in spec: 149 files, 4588 passed.

## Contract review 6518256754 (FAIL on `ecf8b5c4`), fixed in `10deba35`; delta 6518728501 PASS

- **Must-fix, ADR §4.6.** The added sentence called `odata` the one vocabulary that is not SQL; `mongo` maps BSON type names too, as the `SqlDialect` doc comment says. The sentence now names both, pointing at `DIALECT_ALIASES.mongo` and `DIALECT_ALIASES.odata`.
- **Should-fix, same sentence.** It now says the odata arm leaves `Edm.Duration` and the `Edm.Geography*` / `Edm.Geometry*` families unmapped so a draft flags them for review.
- **Should-fix, `type-compat.ts` row comment.** "Never a UUID" held for minted ids only. The comment now says a minted id is never a UUID or an integer, and a caller-supplied id is stored verbatim as a string, which is why the `uuid` row keeps `user`.
- **PR body.** The opening paragraph no longer names a model beyond the card's own "Fable review owed" marker.
- The review's ③ also closed the memory and Mongo driver note below: `driver-memory` mints an `objectName-timestamp-counter` string and `driver-mongodb` a 16-character nanoid.

Delta review 6518728501 by the same reviewer: PASS on `10deba35`, every finding closed.

Re-run in full on `10deba35`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived the same 85 families; all 85 run with exit codes recorded. Five spec gates (api-surface, browser-reachable-entries, dual-source-exports, entry-nameability, exported-any) exited 3 on the stale spec `dist/` and exit 0 after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`. `--ran`: 85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).

## Acceptance notes

- **Integer rows.** Left closed by measurement, not by caution. If a deployment ever configures better-auth with numeric ids, that is a new id shape and its own card.
- **Memory and Mongo drivers** mint their own ids for engine-direct writes, both strings (read by the contract review, not measured here). Every user the platform creates goes through better-auth, which mints the id before the driver sees the row.
